name: instead_of_on_view
comment: INSTEAD OF on a view exists on every dialect: the body redirects the write. PostgreSQL's function returns the row (new) for an insert.

trigger.name: trg_widget_summaries_insert
trigger.sql: insert into widgets (name) select n.name from {new: name} n;

create:
create trigger trg_widget_summaries_insert instead of insert on widget_summaries for each row
begin
insert into widgets (name) select n.name from (select new.name as name) n;
end

drop: if object_id(N'trg_widget_summaries_insert', N'TR') is not null drop trigger [trg_widget_summaries_insert]

create: create trigger "trg_widget_summaries_insert" instead of insert on "widget_summaries" for each row execute function "trg_widget_summaries_insert_fn"()
